items.title_en: ‘In Total Rs 20,000 A Day’: Bengaluru Man Left Stunned After Driver Reveals Earnings From Cab Driving And C
items.title_zh: “一天总共2万卢比”：司机透露开出租车和C……的收入后，班加罗尔男子感到震惊
items.summary_en: The man shared that the driver made around Rs 4,800 from Uber alone by 10:30 pm and then he also earned around Rs 15,000 a day by renting his 10 Ertigas in Mumbai
items.summary_zh: 这名男子说，到晚上10点30分，司机仅从优步就赚了约4800卢比，此外他还靠在孟买出租自己的10辆Ertiga，每天赚约1.5万卢比。

items.title_en: After Microsoft, JPMorgan Outages, Why There Could Be More Tech Disruptions In Coming Months
items.title_zh: 微软、摩根大通出现中断后，为何未来数月可能有更多技术中断
items.summary_en: US intelligence chief Jay Clayton and Microsoft President Brad Smith warn of more tech outages in the coming months as AI advances and companies upgrade ageing infrastructure and cybersecurity systems., Technology & Science, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 美国情报首长杰伊·克莱顿和微软总裁布拉德·史密斯警告，随着人工智能发展，以及企业升级老旧基础设施和网络安全系统，未来数月可能出现更多技术中断。

items.title_en: Superintelligence Is Arriving: Meta AI Chief Alexandr Wang Warns Humanity Has One Year To Prepare
items.title_zh: 超级智能正在到来：Meta人工智能负责人亚历山大·王警告，人类有一年时间做准备
items.summary_en: Wang believes the world is approaching a major turning point and the next one year could play an important role in deciding humanity's future., Technology & Science, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 王认为，世界正接近一个重大转折点，接下来的一年可能在决定人类未来方面发挥重要作用。

items.title_en: 'Why Are You Stopping Me?': Police Stop YS Sharmila Near Bengaluru Airport, Deny Entry to Yelahanka Family Palace
items.title_zh: “你为什么拦我？”：警方在班加罗尔机场附近拦下YS·沙尔米拉，拒绝其进入耶拉汉卡家族宫殿
items.summary_en: Sharmila had arrived in Bengaluru along with her mother YS Vijayamma, son Raja Reddy, and daughter-in-law Priya Atluri. As they were preparing to leave the airport for the Yelahanka palace, police stopped their vehicles near the Air Force station, Yelahanka.
items.summary_zh: 沙尔米拉与母亲YS·维贾亚玛、儿子拉贾·雷迪和儿媳普里亚·阿特卢里一同抵达班加罗尔。他们准备离开机场前往耶拉汉卡宫殿时，警方在耶拉汉卡空军站附近拦下了他们的车辆。

items.title_en: US lawmaker whose viral ‘eyes’ video sparked bizarre lizard people theories reacts: ‘Obviously I’m a human being’
items.title_zh: 走红“眼睛”视频引发离奇“蜥蜴人”说法的美国议员回应：“我显然是人类”
items.summary_en: US lawmaker Jordan Wright went viral after his eye movement, caught on camera during a speech by Zohran Mamdani, sparked a frenzy on social media.
items.summary_zh: 美国议员乔丹·赖特走红，起因是他在佐赫兰·马姆达尼演讲期间被拍到的眼部动作在社交媒体上引发热议。

items.title_en: Inside GTA 6, developers immortalise loved ones who passed away before the game’s release: “Miss you Mum’
items.title_zh: 《GTA 6》中，开发者把游戏发售前去世的亲人永远留在游戏里：“想你了，妈妈”
items.summary_en: Some GTA 6 developers have moved fans by revealing hidden in-game memorials for their late family members.
items.summary_zh: 一些《GTA 6》开发者公开了游戏里为已故家人设置的隐藏纪念，打动了粉丝。

items.title_en: Democrats Hit 258 House Seats, Largest Majority Of The Century After North Carolina Win
items.title_zh: 民主党众议院席位达到258席，北卡罗来纳州胜选后取得本世纪最大多数
items.summary_en: Democrats reached 258 House seats after Chuck Hubbard beat Virginia Foxx in North Carolina by 330 votes, securing the largest House majority by any party this century, with four races still left undecided.
items.summary_zh: 查克·哈伯德在北卡罗来纳州以330票的优势击败弗吉尼亚·福克斯后，民主党众议院席位达到258席，取得本世纪任何政党中最大的众议院多数，仍有4场选举尚未决出。

items.title_en: Delta Flights To And From Atlanta Delayed After Weight-Balance System Fails
items.title_zh: 重量平衡系统故障后，达美航空往返亚特兰大的航班延误
items.summary_en: All Delta flights to and from Atlanta were delayed on Sunday after the weight-and-balance automation system failed, forcing manual calculations, with over 40% of Delta flights at Hartsfield-Jackson delayed by 9 am.
items.summary_zh: 周日，重量与平衡自动化系统发生故障，迫使改用人工计算，达美航空所有往返亚特兰大的航班因此延误。到上午9点，哈茨菲尔德-杰克逊机场超过40%的达美航班出现延误。

items.title_en: US Spy Chief Confirms Probes Into Alice Huang And Megaspeed Remain Ongoing Amid Nvidia Row
items.title_zh: 英伟达争议中，美国情报首长确认对爱丽丝·黄和Megaspeed的调查仍在进行
items.summary_en: DNI Jay Clayton confirmed probes into Alice Huang and Megaspeed remain ongoing, saying Nvidia's board and regulators are also expected to review the matter after former CEO Jensen Huang resigned on November 12.
items.summary_zh: 国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿确认，对爱丽丝·黄和Megaspeed的调查仍在进行。他表示，前首席执行官黄仁勋于11月12日辞职后，英伟达董事会和监管机构预计也将审查此事。

items.title_en: 'Most Expensive Sex Since Helen of Troy': US Senator's Brutal Swipe at Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: “自特洛伊的海伦以来最昂贵的性”：美国参议员猛烈抨击英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋
items.summary_en: During an interview, US Senator John Kennedy expressed concerns about national security implications due to Nvidia's role in AI and the alleged breach of US export controls by a company linked to Jensen Huang, US News, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 在一次采访中，美国参议员约翰·肯尼迪对国家安全方面的影响表示关切，原因是英伟达在人工智能中的角色，以及一家与黄仁勋有关联的公司涉嫌违反美国出口管制。

items.title_en: Serbia's Student-Led Government Wants Reality TV Capped at 45 Minutes and a Four-Day Work Week
items.title_zh: 塞尔维亚学生领导的政府希望把真人秀限制在45分钟，并实行每周四天工作制
items.summary_en: Serbia's new student-led government plans to limit reality TV to 45 minutes a day on free-to-air channels and encourage a four-day, 32-hour work week without pay cuts. The proposals mark a break from the Vučić era, which relied on cheap labor to attract foreign investors. , World News, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 塞尔维亚新一届学生领导的政府计划，把免费开路频道的真人秀限制为每天45分钟，并鼓励在不减薪的情况下实行每周四天、32小时工作制。这些提议标志着与武契奇时代的决裂。武契奇时代依靠廉价劳动力吸引外国投资者。

items.title_en: US Braces for More Tech Disruptions as Intelligence Chief Issues Stark Warning
items.title_zh: 情报首长发出严厉警告，美国准备应对更多技术中断
items.summary_en: Recent outages affected critical services, including air travel and banking, but were not linked to cyber attacks, US News, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 近期中断影响了航空出行和银行等关键服务，但与网络攻击无关。

items.title_en: Bessent's Nvidia U-Turn: Called for Fresh Leadership, Now Suggests Jensen's Return Is Possible
items.title_zh: 贝森特在英伟达问题上转变立场：曾呼吁启用新领导层，如今表示黄仁勋有可能回归
items.summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent previously called for significant leadership changes at Nvidia, criticizing its culture and hinting at potential revenue manipulation. However, he recently softened his stance amidst growing support in Silicon Valley for Jensen Huang's return. , US News, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特此前呼吁对英伟达作重大领导层调整，批评其文化，并暗示可能存在收入操纵。不过，随着硅谷对黄仁勋回归的支持日益增加，他最近软化了立场。

items.title_en: Shashi Tharoor tries GTA 6 for the first time, says ‘I’m afraid I’m not a game player’
items.title_zh: 沙希·塔鲁尔第一次试玩《GTA 6》，说“恐怕我不是游戏玩家”
items.summary_en: Shashi Tharoor admitted that neither the setting nor the characters in GTA 6 appealed to him.
items.summary_zh: 沙希·塔鲁尔承认，《GTA 6》的场景和角色都没有吸引他。

items.title_en: India-EU FTA Likely to be Signed During PM Modi's Europe Visit in December: Official
items.title_zh: 官方称，印度与欧盟自由贸易协定可能在莫迪总理12月访欧期间签署
items.summary_en: PM Modi is expected to undertake a four-nation tour, combining his visits to Europe and the US, for key strategic bilateral and multilateral engagement.
items.summary_zh: 莫迪总理预计将进行四国访问，把对欧洲和美国的访问合在一起，开展关键的战略双边和多边接触。

items.title_en: India Flags Lack of Equity, Dilution of Climate Responsibilities as COP31 Talks Collapse Without Pact
items.title_zh: 印度指出缺乏公平、气候责任被稀释，COP31谈判未达成协议即破裂
items.summary_en: Amandeep Garg, Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, raised concerns during the closing plenary, pointing to the dilution of historical responsibility and the obligations of developed countries in the negotiated text.
items.summary_zh: 印度环境、森林与气候变化部附加秘书阿曼迪普·加尔格在闭幕全体会议上提出关切，指出谈判文本稀释了历史责任以及发达国家的义务。
